crossRefs.note: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those…
My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

translations.web: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
translations.bsb: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
translations.kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
translations.asv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness. Psalm 89 Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
